adjudication.rationale: In `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts`, the email send is wrapped in `try { await sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests); } catch (err) { console.log("Error sending AddGuestsEmails"); }`. This discards `err`, uses `console.log` instead of any structured/codebase logger, and omits useful context (e.g., `bookingId`, organizer/user, guest list). The behavior is verifiably present in the diff; it’s primarily an observability/operational robustness issue rather than a definite correctness defect because the mutation still completes after updating attendees/calendar.
